title: Woven into one
label: A wide jacquard loom. Six labelled spools feed bands of coloured warp threads down to the weaving line, where hooks lift the threads row by row and a shuttle lays the weft. The cloth scrolls down toward the beam, and the letters O, N and E emerge in it, woven from the tools' coloured threads on a pale twill ground.
heading: Woven into one.
sub: Every tool your team uses, made into a single fabric with your name in it.
name: ONE
